Will's book, The Outsiders, is one of the best business and investing books that you'll find.

thesis: The episode introduces a new series called 50X that dissects investments which have appreciated at least 50-fold by exploring their origins, evolution, and outcomes. The host, Will Thorndike, interviews Nick Howley, the driving force at TransDigm, to discuss the company's extraordinary 28-year return profile and unique shareholder value creation.
